items.title: Google unveils Pixel 11 lineup, new AirTag rival, and Gemini features at Made by Google 2026
items.author: Lauren Forristal
items.content: <article>From the Pixel 11 series and a brand new competitor to Apple’s AirTag, here are all the announcements from the Made by Google 2026 event. </article>

items.title: Google’s Quick Share adds a tap-to-share mode
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Google's Quick Share feature is getting a tap-to-share mode for quickly exchanging contacts, photos, videos, and more. </article>

items.title: Google’s new Pixel 11 Pro Fold offers a stronger build and brighter screens
items.author: Ivan Mehta
items.content: <article>The Pixel 11 Pro Fold will cost $1,899</article>

items.title: Google takes on AirTag with the new $29 Pixel Tag
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Google’s new Pixel Tag taps into its Find Hub network to help users track lost keys, bags, and other items.</article>

items.title: Google unveils the Pixel Watch 5 with a smarter Gemini and advanced health monitoring
items.author: Aisha Malik
items.content: <article>The new smartwatch, which starts at $399, can track blood pressure patterns and insulin resistance, as well as deliver personalized help and better sleep tracking. </article>

items.title: Google’s Pixel 11 lineup offer fewer hardware changes, but much more Gemini
items.author: Ivan Mehta
items.content: <article>Google Pixel 11 Series starts $100 costlier than the last year, but offers 256GB base storage</article>

items.title: AI code-testing startup Blacksmith’s valuation jumps almost 10x in less than a year
items.author: Jagmeet Singh
items.content: <article>Blacksmith says revenue has grown more than tenfold over the past year.</article>

items.title: Reservoir raises $8M to make water heaters that people — and the grid — will actually want
items.author: Tim De Chant
items.content: <article>Reservoir has built an ultra-efficient water heater that can predict hot water demand, store energy, and detect plumbing leaks throughout a home.</article>

items.title: India’s Yulu raises $93M as quick-commerce boom fuels e-bike demand
items.author: Jagmeet Singh
items.content: <article>Yulu aims to have a fleet of 200,000 bikes in the next two years and faster electric two-wheelers, aiming at new logistics use cases.</article>

items.title: Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni reportedly knew Phia was ‘cookie stuffing’ for months
items.author: Dominic-Madori Davis
items.content: <article>Phia, the shopping startup co-founded by Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, is once again under fire for its alleged business practices.</article>

items.title: Accel closes oversubscribed $550M India fund within weeks, 19 months after its last
items.author: Jagmeet Singh
items.content: <article>The U.S. VC firm still has more than 55% of its previous $650 million India fund available for deployment.</article>

items.title: Uber surprised robotics company Serve by selling its entire stake
items.author: Kirsten Korosec
items.content: <article>The divestiture comes as the two once-tight companies have started to diverge on the business side. </article>

items.title: FBI says cybercriminals are hacking into victims’ online accounts to steal their intimate pictures
items.author: Lorenzo Franceschi-Bicchierai
items.content: <article>In a new alert, the FBI said cybercriminals are targeting adults and minors in an attempt to steal their personal and intimate pictures in extortion campaigns.</article>

items.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT desktop app for Linux
items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: <article>OpenAI is finally bringing a dedicated ChatGPT desktop app to Linux operating systems. </article>

items.title: Google’s Gemini app surges to 1 billion users
items.author: Lauren Forristal
items.content: <article>Google also shared numbers of how people are actually using the chatbot, with 63% of Gemini users talking directly to the assistant using the voice feature. Plus, Gemini now generates more than 150 million images every day, according to Google. </article>

items.title: Bluesky’s active user base is shrinking as its focus expands beyond the app
items.author: Sarah Perez
items.content: <article>Over a year following its post-election surge, Bluesky’s mobile app is seeing a continued decline in active users, though its remaining community is still relatively engaged.</article>

items.title: What’s Scaleup Europe, the $5.7B fund that just backed satellite company ICEYE?
items.author: Anna Heim
items.content: <article>Scaleup Europe, a public-private fund with a $5.7 billion target, made its first investment by backing Finnish satellite company ICEYE.</article>

items.title: Brad Lightcap, OpenAI’s longtime COO, is leaving to ‘start something new’
items.author: Lucas Ropek
items.content: <article>One of OpenAI's longest-serving executives is headed out the door, although the longtime COO told staff that he was "excited to help you all advance the mission from a different vantage point."</article>

items.title: General Catalyst leads $1.1B round into 2-month-old River AI
items.author: Julie Bort
items.content: <article>River AI, a startup founded by xAI co-founder Igor Babuschkin, has a fascinating vision for personal agents and secured $1.1 billion out of the gate.</article>

items.title: An unreleased Anthropic model made progress on one of math’s biggest unsolved problems
items.author: Russell Brandom
items.content: <article>For more than 150 years, the Riemann hypothesis has stood as one of the major unsolved problems in mathematics. Anthropic hasn't solved it — but the company's models made more progress than you might expect.</article>
